title: Simulation Task
description: Develop a multi-agent simulation system that models the spread of mask-wearing behavior through social networks.
simulation_focus: Predict agents' mask-wearing behavior over day 30 - day 39 (last ten days) based on their attributes, social connections, and past behavior
Model information propagation and behavioral changes triggered by social influence and government intervention starting on Day 10

data_files.agent_attributes.csv: Contains demographic and behavioral attributes of each agent, including age, occupation, risk perception, and social connection counts
data_files.social_network.json: Contains structured data representing a social network. Each entry corresponds to a user (identified by a unique integer ID), and the values describe the different types of relationships that user has with others. Data Structure: The top-level structure is a dictionary ({} in JSON). Keys: Each key is a unique user ID (as an integer, e.g., 0, 1, 2, etc.). Values: Each value is another dictionary with the following fields: "family": a list of user IDs representing family connections. "work_school": a list of user IDs representing colleagues or schoolmates. "community": a list of user IDs representing community-level acquaintances. "all": a merged list of all user IDs connected to the user across the three categories above.
data_files.train_data.csv: Time series data for the first 30 days, used for training the model

RMSE.description: Root Mean Square Error measuring overall predictive accuracy of mask adoption rates
RMSE.interpretation: Directly interpretable as percentage deviations due to the 0-1 range

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Persons observe neighbors' mask status via SocialLinks and update beliefs/propensity based on weighted influence and thresholds.

interactions.name: normative_pressure
interactions.description: Community-level mask norms exert additional pressure on Persons to adopt or maintain mask use.

interactions.name: information_campaign
interactions.description: PublicHealthAuthority broadcasts messages that modify Persons' risk perception, perceived benefits/costs, and trust-based compliance.

interactions.name: mandate_enforcement
interactions.description: PublicHealthAuthority activates mandates with enforcement; Persons weigh penalties/subsidies and adjust mask decisions.

interactions.name: network_rewiring
interactions.description: Persons probabilistically rewire ties based on homophily/similarity, which alters future influence pathways.

interactions.name: information_sharing
interactions.description: Persons share signals/opinions that affect neighbors' beliefs with noise and tie-weight modulation.

interactions.name: group_event
interactions.description: Communities host events that temporarily increase interaction frequency and influence strength among attendees.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of Persons wearing masks at each time step and at end of simulation.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_by_community
metrics.description: Mask adoption fraction within each Community over time.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption reaches 50%.

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption reaches 70%.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption fraction and the day it occurs.

metrics.name: adoption_churn_rate
metrics.description: Rate at which Persons switch mask_status between time steps.

metrics.name: policy_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of Persons complying during mandate periods.

metrics.name: campaign_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in adoption attributable to campaigns versus a no-campaign baseline.

metrics.name: assortativity_by_mask_status
metrics.description: Network assortativity coefficient measuring clustering of adopters with adopters vs non-adopters.

metrics.name: behavioral_R
metrics.description: Early-phase ratio of new adopters caused per current adopter (behavioral reproduction number).

metrics.name: inequality_in_adoption_gini
metrics.description: Gini coefficient of adoption rates across Communities or demographic groups.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_stability
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change remains below epsilon for K consecutive days (e.g., |Δadoption| < 0.001 for 10 days).

validation_criteria.name: population_conservation
validation_criteria.description: Total number of Persons remains constant throughout the simulation.

validation_criteria.name: bounds_sanity_check
validation_criteria.description: All probabilities and rates remain within [0,1]; mask_status is binary {0,1}.

validation_criteria.name: reproducibility_with_seed
validation_criteria.description: Fixed random_seed yields identical trajectories across runs.

validation_criteria.name: baseline_behavior_check
validation_criteria.description: With influence_strength=0 and campaign_intensity=0, adoption remains near initial_adoption_rate up to stochastic drift.
